name: Drip
description_en:
Drip is built around ecommerce email marketing, onsite audience capture and behavior-based automation. Its pricing FAQ says a store is not mandatory, but its positioning favors online merchants. A Workflow connects a trigger to actions, decisions, delays, goals and exits; the practical task is to turn a customer action into an appropriate follow-up while stopping messages that have become irrelevant.

Its fit depends on the events and permissions behind that workflow. A purchase goal is useful only if purchase data arrives reliably, and a contact being Active is not proof of marketing consent. The assessment below concentrates on these operational distinctions. It does not establish deliverability, revenue lift or integration reliability through hands-on testing.
description_zh:
Drip 面向电商邮件营销、站内受众获取与行为自动化。定价 FAQ 说明并非必须拥有商店，但其定位更偏向在线商家。Workflow 将触发器连接到动作、决策、等待、目标及退出，实际任务是把客户行为转为适当跟进，并停止已经失去相关性的消息。

是否适用取决于流程背后的事件与接收权限。只有购买数据可靠到达时，购买目标才有意义；联系人处于 Active 状态也不代表已经同意接收营销邮件。以下评估聚焦这些操作区别，未通过实测确认投递效果、营收提升或集成可靠性。

core_features.explanation_en: A qualifying person can skip intervening steps to reach a downstream Goal.
core_features.explanation_zh: 符合条件者可跳过中间步骤，到达下游 Goal。

core_features.explanation_en: Exit removes a person and permits later entry after a new qualifying trigger.
core_features.explanation_zh: Exit 移除人员，之后新的合格触发可使其再次进入。

core_features.explanation_en: Active status and marketing subscription are independent dimensions.
core_features.explanation_zh: Active 状态与营销订阅是不同维度。

core_features.explanation_en: Current and Done distinguish waiting people from passed-through nodes.
core_features.explanation_zh: Current 与 Done 区分仍在节点等待的人及已通过节点的计数。

en: Editorial fit: an online merchant with reliable purchase events that wants welcome and post-purchase journeys.
Editorial fit: a lifecycle operator prepared to inspect pause behavior and explicitly handle non-converter exits.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：具备可靠购买事件，希望建立欢迎及购后旅程的在线商家。
编辑判断的适用场景：愿意核对暂停行为，并明确处理未转化者出口的生命周期运营人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose one business event and write expected entry and exit behavior before importing people.
steps.zh: 导入人员前，选定一个业务事件并写清预期入场与退出行为。

steps.en: Separate active-record status from marketing preference in the migration mapping.
steps.zh: 在迁移映射中区分活动记录状态与营销接收偏好。

steps.en: Restrict all relevant entry paths to approved internal test profiles before activating an evaluation workflow.
steps.zh: 激活评估流程前，将所有相关入口限定到批准的内部测试档案。

steps.en: Inspect a non-converter exit and a purchase during a pause, then confirm the account quote.
steps.zh: 检查未转化者出口及暂停期间购买情形，再确认账户报价。

items.en: No hands-on store integration, test send, goal replay or billing reconciliation was performed.
items.zh: 未实际接入商店、测试发送、重放目标事件或核对账单。

items.en: Parent pause does not stop nested email series or reset elapsed delays.
items.zh: 暂停父流程不会停止嵌套邮件系列，也不会重置已流逝等待时间。

items.en: Current SMS onboarding eligibility is unresolved: older search snippets differ from the current billing page, which directs users to support.
items.zh: 当前短信开通资格仍未解决：旧搜索片段与当前计费页不同，当前页要求联系支持。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The official pricing FAQ documents active-person and monthly-send-volume pricing, a 14-day trial without a credit card, and no unlimited-email allowance during that trial. A store is not mandatory. No calculator amount was exposed in the actual web read; a later normal HTTPS request returned HTTP 403 and was not retried through another route. Paid starting amounts, exact send allowance and SMS terms remain unconfirmed; no normalized price or sustained-free claim is made.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方定价 FAQ 说明按 Active 人数及月发送量定价，提供无需信用卡的 14 天试用，且试用期间不包含无限量邮件。使用并非必须拥有商店。实际网页读取未显示计算器金额；之后正常 HTTPS 请求返回 HTTP 403，未换路径重试。付费起价、具体发送额度与短信条款仍未确认；不生成标准化价格，也不宣称持续免费。

sources.title: Drip Ecommerce Marketing Software Pricing | Get Started with Drip
sources.research_notes_en: Read ecommerce positioning, 14-day no-card trial, restricted trial email allowance and active-person/send-volume pricing. No calculator amount was visible. A subsequent ordinary HTTPS request returned 403; no alternate endpoint or transport was used afterward.

sources.title: Create a Workflow – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read forward-only triggers, component types and 50-active-workflow limit for accounts created after June 2020.

sources.title: Workflows: Goals – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read downstream-only goal jumps, optional entry at a goal, side-by-side OR and default email-series unsubscribe on goal achievement.

sources.title: Workflows: Exits – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read immutable bottom Exit, later re-entry after a new trigger and goal-related exitless paths blocking re-triggering while still active.

sources.title: Pause a Workflow – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read paused actions versus continuing delay clocks, captured goals and continuing nested workflows or email series. Pausing a parent is not a universal communication stop.

sources.title: Go Beyond Email and Engage with All People Through Drip – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read Active/Inactive status separately from marketing preference. Active unsubscribed and default active undeliverable records can remain billable.

sources.title: Import Data into Drip – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read separate subscribed/unsubscribed CSV imports, explicit unsubscribe operation and 30-second cancellation window. No import performed.

sources.title: How to Test a Workflow – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read real activated test procedure restricting trigger filters to approved test addresses and performing the trigger action; not an offline simulator.

sources.title: Workflow Settings – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read node Current/Done counts, tracking continuing while analytics display disabled, and activation to-do list; not causal revenue measurement.

sources.title: How We Calculate Your Bill – Drip Help Center
sources.research_notes_en: Read prior-period high-watermark model, deletion not reducing current-period peak, aggregate accounts, high-volume auto-upgrade and support-enabled SMS. Current original wording differs from older search snippets.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A trigger is a future event, not a backfill request
sections.en: Workflow triggers act after activation; existing historical matches do not automatically enter. The creation guide lists 50 active Workflows for accounts created after June 2020. A migration therefore needs its own enrollment decision rather than an assumption that turning on a copied workflow recreates old journeys. Keep a small expected-entry table: a new signup, an old imported signup and a second event from someone still inside. This is a suggested evaluation exercise, not an executed import.
sections.zh: Workflow 触发器在激活后生效，既有历史匹配者不会自动进入。创建指南对 2020 年 6 月之后创建的账户列出 50 个活动 Workflow 的限制。迁移需要单独决定入场方式，不能假定启用复制的流程就会恢复旧旅程。可准备一张预期入场表：新注册者、导入的历史注册者，以及仍在流程中的人员再次产生事件。这是建议的评估练习，未实际导入。

sections.title_en: Design a purchase outcome without trapping non-buyers
sections.title_zh: 设计购买终点，同时给未购买者留出路
sections.en: For a hypothetical welcome journey, a purchase Goal can pull someone past remaining introductory messages. Goals only pull downward. They can also become separate entry points when that option is enabled, so the goal must be reviewed as an entrance as well as an outcome. By default, reaching a later Goal unsubscribes the person from an Email Series started in the workflow; a setting can keep that series running. Document which messages should survive the purchase.
sections.zh: 假设欢迎旅程中设有购买 Goal，它可以把人员拉到后面，跳过剩余介绍消息。Goal 只向下拉动。启用相应选项后，它还可成为独立入口，因此需要同时按入口和结果检查。默认情况下，到达后面的 Goal 会取消人员在流程中启动的 Email Series 订阅；设置可以让该系列继续。应明确哪些消息在购买后仍需发送。

sections.title_en: A goal can leave a path waiting indefinitely
sections.title_zh: 目标可能让路径无限等待
sections.en: The bottom Exit cannot be removed, but placing a Goal above it can create an exitless waiting path. People who never achieve the Goal remain active there and cannot re-trigger that workflow. The Exit guide recommends a delay plus an additional exit so there is a route out after allowing time for the Goal. In an evaluation, inspect the non-converter path explicitly; seeing an Exit at the bottom of a diagram is not sufficient proof that everyone can reach it.
sections.zh: 底部 Exit 无法删除，但在它上方放置 Goal 可能形成没有可达出口的等待路径。始终未达到 Goal 的人员会留在其中，无法再次触发该流程。Exit 指南建议加上等待和额外出口，在给 Goal 留出时间后仍提供退出路径。评估时应明确检查未转化者路径；流程图底部存在 Exit，不足以证明所有人都能到达它。

sections.title_en: Pause does not freeze every clock or child process
sections.title_zh: 暂停不会冻结全部时钟或子流程
sections.en: Turning the workflow off disables new trigger entry and pauses Actions. Delay clocks continue, Goal events are captured, and nested Workflows or Email Series can keep running. Once resumed, overdue waits can advance and achieved goals can pull people down. A recovery plan should consider people who bought during the pause and people still receiving a child series. Do not assume a parent toggle alone is a complete sending shutdown.
sections.zh: 关闭流程会禁止新的触发入场并暂停 Actions。Delay 继续计时，Goal 事件仍被记录，嵌套 Workflow 或 Email Series 也可能继续运行。恢复后，已超时的等待可继续推进，已达到的目标可向下拉动人员。恢复方案应考虑暂停期间购买的人，以及仍在接收子系列消息的人。不能认为只切换父流程开关就完整停止了发送。

sections.title_en: Preserve preference separately from record activity
sections.title_zh: 分别保留接收偏好与记录活动状态
sections.en: Active records can be subscribed or unsubscribed from marketing. An unsubscribed Active person can remain tracked and billable; Inactive status stops engagement and new data collection under the documented model. The import guide therefore calls for separate subscribed and unsubscribed CSV imports, explicitly applying Unsubscribe a person > All mailings to the latter. It allows only 30 seconds to cancel a scheduled operation. Preview a small synthetic sample and preserve source suppression information before a real migration.
sections.zh: Active 记录既可能订阅营销，也可能已退订。已退订但仍 Active 的人员仍可被跟踪并计费；文档模型中，Inactive 状态会停止互动及新数据采集。因此导入指南要求分别导入已订阅与已退订 CSV，并对后者明确应用 Unsubscribe a person > All mailings。已排期操作只有 30 秒可以取消。真实迁移前应预览小型合成样本，并保留源系统抑制信息。

sections.title_en: Test an activated workflow with a restricted audience
sections.title_zh: 限制受众后测试已激活流程
sections.en: The testing article describes restricting Trigger Filters to approved addresses or a saved segment, turning the workflow ON and performing the trigger event. This is a live path with potential effects, not an offline preview. Node analytics can then distinguish Current from Done; hiding the analytics display does not stop background tracking. A completed node is evidence of progression, not proof that a recipient read a message or that the workflow caused a purchase. No such account test was performed for this profile.
sections.zh: 测试文章的程序是：用 Trigger Filters 限定批准的地址或已保存分群，将流程打开，再产生触发事件。这是真实且可能产生影响的路径，不是离线预览。节点分析可以区分 Current 与 Done；隐藏分析显示不会停止后台记录。完成节点说明流程推进，不代表收件人已阅读消息，也不能证明流程促成购买。本稿未执行这种账户测试。

sections.en: Billing uses prior-period high-watermark usage for Active people and email sends, with applicable SMS dimensions handled separately. Deleting or deactivating people does not erase the current cycle’s peak, and multiple accounts contribute to the total. High Volume sends can cause an automatic tier change. Before importing a large archive, model its peak active population and the operational consequences of deactivation. The current public reader did not expose a calculator amount, so an old directory starting price is not retained as a current quote.
sections.zh: 计费依据上一周期 Active 人数与邮件发送量的高水位，适用的短信维度另外处理。删除或停用人员不会抹去本周期峰值，多个账户也参与总量计算。High Volume 发送量可能导致自动升档。导入大量历史档案前，应估算活动人数峰值，以及停用带来的操作影响。当前公开读取结果未显示计算器金额，因此不把旧目录起价保留为当前报价。

seo.title_en: Drip: ecommerce email workflows, goals and pause behavior
seo.title_zh: Drip：电商邮件流程、目标与暂停行为
seo.description_en: Evaluate Drip workflow entry, goal jumps, exitless paths, live testing and high-watermark billing from official documentation.
seo.description_zh: 依据官方文档评估 Drip 入场、目标跳转、无出口路径、真实测试及高水位计费。
seo.primary_intent: Understand Drip ecommerce workflow behavior and billing
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Exact current quote and email limits were not visible; pricing HTTPS retrieval returned 403 after an earlier successful public reader excerpt.
research_gaps.zh: 具体当前报价与邮件额度不可见；先前公开读取器取得内容后，HTTPS 获取定价页返回 403。

research_gaps.en: SMS eligibility, UI languages, hosting rights and integration-specific event guarantees remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 短信资格、界面语言、托管权利及具体集成的事件保证仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: No independent outcome measurement or customer deployment evidence was collected.
research_gaps.zh: 未采集独立效果测量或客户部署证据。
